name: Financial Incentives To Mothers Who Deliver A Girl Child (Mamta)
benefit:
1. ₹ 10,000/- as a one-time financial incentive (at the birth of the child). 1. Those beneficiaries who had applied for the 1st Installment of ₹ 5,000/- (as on the date of this Amended Scheme published in the Official Gazette) shall be eligible for ₹ 10,000/- as per the amended scheme.
**NOTE 1:** Those beneficiaries who were paid the 1st Installment of ₹ 5,000/- under the existing scheme s
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a mother who has delivered a live Girl Child in a registered medical institution.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Goa for at least three years. OR
1. The applicant should be married to a resident of Goa.
1. The application for the scheme should have been made within 45 days of the delivery.

**NOTE:** The scheme is available to all mothers, irrespective of their social/economic status.
